chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Jaʿfar ibn Bashīr, from al-ʿArzamī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Indeed, among the people with the longest necks on the Day of qiyamah will be the mu'adhdhins.

key_terms.أَطْوَلِ: greatest in length; indicating distinction and prominence
key_terms.أَعْنَاقًا: necks; an expression signifying visible eminence on the Day of qiyamah
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Resurrection and final reckoning

ai.seo_question: What reward do the mu'adhdhins receive on the Day of qiyamah?
ai.summary: This hadith praises the mu'adhdhins and highlights their special distinction on the Day of qiyamah. It presents calling the adhan as an honored act of worship with manifest reward in the afterlife.
